name: Atlassian (Rovo MCP)
description: Atlassian's official Rovo MCP server. Search and read Confluence pages and spaces, and work with Jira issues, as an admin-managed Atlassian service account.

requiredSecrets.description: An org admin must first enable Rovo > Rovo MCP server > Authentication > Allow API token authentication. Then create a service account (Directory > Service accounts) with the Confluence User role, and an API token for it with read:page:confluence, read:space:confluence, search:confluence, read:confluence:agent-interface and search:confluence:agent-interface (add write:confluence:agent-interface for page edits). Add your site's cloudId to the agent instructions.
